## Services

- ERP Implementation & Scaling - Architect, migrate, and scale ERPNext/Frappe on AWS,
  from a single-server install to a horizontally scaled, cloud-native platform.
- Architecture & Performance Audits - Profile and redesign slow or fragile systems with
  measurable before/after results (e.g. an 8.7x speedup on ERPNext's core stock ledger).
- ITGC & Audit / IPO Readiness - RBAC with activity logging, maker-checker workflows
  enforcing segregation of duties, and audit-evidence frameworks mapping to SOX/ITGC.

## Selected work

- Scaling SolarSquare's ERP to 450+ users - Re-architected ERPNext into a horizontally
  scaled AWS platform: auto-scaling web tier (Gunicorn/Nginx/SocketIO), dedicated worker
  fleet, ElastiCache Redis, RDS MariaDB, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM. Serves 450+ users
  across B2B and B2C operations.
- Preventing ~Rs 20 Lakh in logistics losses - Built inventory-tracking workflows and data
  pipelines that surfaced mid-mile logistics discrepancies, preventing roughly Rs 20 Lakh
  in losses and improving warehouse efficiency.
- Audit & IPO readiness (ITGC) - Custom RBAC, maker-checker approval workflows on sensitive
  financial transactions, and an audit framework capturing access/change/approval evidence
  into structured reports addressing SOX and ITGC control domains.
- ERPNext core contribution, PR #51644 - Refactored get_stock_ledgers_for_serial_nos onto
  ERPNext v15's Serial and Batch Bundle model. Cut query time ~583s -> ~67s (~8.7x faster)
  and database queries ~104K -> ~14.5K (~86% fewer). https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/51644
- Event-management ERP for Amba Tech (NGO) - End-to-end ERP with an Angular web app, mobile
  app, and Metabase dashboards, including a QR-based attendance system. Pro bono.

## Experience

- SolarSquare Energy - Software Development Engineer II (SDE-2), Oct 2024 – Present.

  rule engines using SQL and SAS.
